extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.63[CR]- Play Amazon HD through stock Windows Kodi using the bundled CDM adapter and genuine installed Chrome Widevine; no modified Kodi required.[CR]- Correct canonical feature-title resolution, license key callback timing, unknown H264 profile mapping and native transport throughput.[CR]- Request quality automatically and retain bounded lower-quality retries when Amazon refuses authorization.[CR]- Refresh account runtime and the open catalog after sign-in; preserve root Back navigation and playback return.[CR]- Keep accumulated regional media, resume, subtitle, artwork and catalog fixes; remove retired native PlayReady and host-verification experiments.[CR]- Collect redacted native, license, output-protection, stream-quality and shutdown diagnostics.[CR]- Windows HD currently requires installed 64-bit Chrome 158.0.8127.37; other Chrome versions use the standard playback route.
